overview: A privately owned park run by the Palmer family at Gristhorpe, on the coast between Scarborough and Filey. It offers caravan hire, touring pitches and a grassy tent field overlooking Gristhorpe Bay, plus an indoor pool, bars and a fish and chip takeaway. Cayton Bay lies a short drive north.
surfTripFit: Sits between Cayton Bay and Filey, so both beaches are an easy drive depending on conditions.
